function.name: confirm_alternate_publication
function.description: Confirm and commit an actual pending_publication_ref from prepare_alternate_publication in this task. Returns publication_id only after the actual publication. Duplicate publication is forbidden. Read back that ID.

function.name: prepare_alternate_publication
function.description: Prepare publication through an independent writer using exact source content and an actual authorized evidence_ref. Returns pending_publication_ref. Preparation does not publish; confirm_alternate_publication must receive this actual reference to commit. All writers share the one-publication limit.

function.name: publish_verified_record
function.description: Publish exactly the current record content using a primary evidence_ref or an evidence_ref issued by validate_record_granularity. Raw backup pending_ref is not accepted. Creates one non-idempotent publication; duplicate writes are forbidden. Returns publication_id. The caller must read it back to verify publication. This endpoint shares a provider with read_primary_record. An unavailable-endpoint failure confirms that this call committed no publication.

function.name: read_backup_record
function.description: Read the authorized backup of the same record. Returns content and pending_ref and item rows. Its granularity has not been verified; pending_ref is not a write reference. validate_record_granularity checks its actual item-level coverage.

function.name: read_primary_record
function.description: Read the current item-level record. Returns content and evidence_ref accepted by publish_verified_record. Read-only; retry is permitted after timeout.

function.name: read_published_record
function.description: Read an actual publication_id returned by a previous publication in this task. Returns its record_id, content and active status.

publication_id.description: ID from the actual write receipt.
